verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is a developer-facing SDK/API (exec(), readFile/writeFile, code interpreter, etc.) meant to be called programmatically by an agent or app code, not a natural-language interface that an end-user interacts with directly. The product's stated purpose is to serve as the execution backend AI agents call into, not to itself parse or respond to natural-language commands, so this axis is a category mismatch rather than an unmet capability.
